title: Introduction to splicelogic
text: splicelogic R/Bioconductor package detecting alternative splicing events exon-level data stored GRanges objects. Given set exons annotated coefficient column indicating differential transcript usage (DTU), splicelogic identifies following types splicing events: Skipped exons (SE) – exons present one isoform absent another. Retained exons (RE) – exons present one isoform absent another. Mutually exclusive exons (MXE) – pairs exons one included expense . Retained introns (RI) – intronic regions retained part exon alternative isoform. Alternative 5’ (A5SS) – exons share 3’ splice site differ 5’ splice site. Alternative 3’ (A3SS) – exons share 5’ splice site differ 3’ splice site.

title: Introduction to splicelogic
text: splicelogic assumes user run differential transcript usage (DTU) differential splicing analysis providing error bound (e.g. adjusted p-value / FDR) effect estimate direction (e.g. GLM estimated coefficient deltaPSI) (see upstream methods). also assumes user obtained genomic ranges representing exon structure transcript analyzed (see obtaining exon ranges). exons provided flat GRanges object (one range per exon), containing exon-level metadata mcols(exons) gene ID, transcript ID, rank transcript, estimated change least direction change differential analysis. Required columns exons: differential effect estimate column specified user preprocess_input(). differential effect estimate associated specific transcript containing exon, minimally indicate direction effect +1/-1. Positive values indicate -regulated exons negative values indicate -regulated exons. exons transcript share value column.

Next, join DTU results onto exons GRanges. necessary splicelogic functions know transcripts - -regulated, gene exons transcripts belong. code matches transcript IDs exons metadata DTU results table, binds two tables assigning back exons. Bioc 3.23 plyranges version 1.32, code add metadata columns additional table can replaced following: splicelogic designed take input exons significantly changed transcripts, first filter transcripts signficant FDR 10%.
code: library(readr) # load DTU results  dir <- system.file("extdata", package="splicelogic") dtu_table <- readr::read_delim(file.path(dir, "dtu_table.tsv")) library(plyranges) exons_file <- "exons_M31.bed.gz" exons_mcols_file <- "exons_mcols.tsv.gz" exons <- plyranges::read_bed(file.path(dir, exons_file)) mcols(exons) <- DataFrame(readr::read_delim(file.path(dir, exons_mcols_file))) si <- Seqinfo::Seqinfo(genome="mm39") seqlevels(exons) <- seqlevels(si) seqinfo(exons) <- si txp_idx <- match(exons$tx_id, dtu_table$tx_id) cols_to_add <- dtu_table[txp_idx, ] |> dplyr::select(-tx_id) merged_DF <- S4Vectors::cbind(mcols(exons), cols_to_add) mcols(exons) <- merged_DF exons <- exons |>    plyranges::join_mcols_left(dtu_table, by = "tx_id") exons <- exons |> filter(padj < .1)

title: Calculate splice events from a GRanges object — calc_events
code: calc_skipped_exons(gr, type = c("boundary", "over", "in"), inverse = FALSE)  calc_included_exons(gr, type = c("boundary", "over", "in"))  calc_mx_exons(gr, type = c("boundary", "in", "over"))  calc_retained_introns(gr)  calc_alt_ss(gr, by_start = TRUE)  calc_a5ss(gr)  calc_a3ss(gr)  calc_all_events(gr, type = c("boundary", "over", "in"), verbose = TRUE)

title: Calculate splice events from a GRanges object — calc_events
text: gr GRanges object exon annotations, including 'tx_id', 'exon', 'coef_col' metadata columns preprocessed preprocess_input(). type type overlap consider identifying events. inverse TRUE, identifies included exons instead skipped exons. by_start TRUE, detects a5ss (exon start, different end). FALSE, detects a3ss (end, different start). verbose TRUE, prints progress messages. Default TRUE.

title: Calculate splice events from a GRanges object — calc_events
text: calc_skipped_exons(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating skipped exons. calc_included_exons(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating included exons. calc_mx_exons(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating mutually exclusive exons. calc_retained_introns(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating retained introns. calc_alt_ss(): GRanges object annotated events alternative splice sites. calc_a5ss(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating a5ss events. calc_a3ss(): GRanges object additional 'event' metadata column indicating a3ss events. calc_all_events(): GRanges object combining detected events, 'event' metadata column indicating event type.
